ESN UWB Pilsen 
Erasmus Student Network UWB Pilsen 
 
ESN UWB Pilsen, a student organization, is dedicated to assisting incoming exchange 
students. The students who serve as Buddies do so voluntarily, demonstrating their 
commitment to helping you settle in. 
If you want to get a Buddy, please register into a Buddy Database: https://buddy.zcu.cz/ (click 
on "SIGN UP", choose the option "Foreign student," and use your name and email which you 
registered into the online registration on Portal to avoid confusions). 
When a Buddy is assigned to you, they will contact you by email, WhatsApp, or FB messenger 
(you indicate your contact information in your profile in the database). 
Here are some helpful links: 
Please fill in this form about your area of interest: https://forms.gle/9pTSF44Epa3ZWQkv9 
Whatsapp community: https://chat.whatsapp.com/GR3OGfL2OxE1RhjJ9VEssv 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/esnuwbpilsen  
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/esnuwbpilsen 
Web: https://buddy.zcu.cz
